cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide symmetrical top-down two-shot of the couple in bed to a tighter close-up on the wife as she delivers her rebuttal ('I literally forwarded you a meme at 2 AM'), pushing in for the joke's setup.
Cuts to a close-up on the husband's deadpan, disappointed face right as he delivers the punchline 'Grow up,' isolating his reaction for maximum comedic emphasis.
Cuts from the husband's held reaction shot to the black title/credit card ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE - CREATED BY NIN.'), closing out the skit immediately after the punchline lands.

reaction_shots.description: Close-up on the husband's flat, unimpressed face as he delivers 'Grow up' — a held reaction shot that is the emotional/comedic payoff rather than new plot action.

pacing_notes: Opens with a longer establishing wide shot (2.4s) to set up the couple's dynamic, then shots tighten as the exchange escalates: a 4.8s close-up carries the bulk of the wife's dialogue, followed by a shorter 2.8s reaction close-up on the husband for the punchline. The final title-card shot is brief (0.9s), landing right after the punchline with no lingering beat, so the joke ends on a clipped, deadpan note rather than a drawn-out CTA.
